lines: Flower petals fluttered through the dark night sky and the guards fell asleep one by one.
The guard drones that weren't affected by the floral scent were struck down by her fantastically versatile thorny whip.
Amazing... So that's why she's called "Shizuru the Flower."
Hebiko watched Shizuru-sensei's gorgeous fighting style with a gleam in her eyes.
(Her specialty is infiltration, but she is a highly capable fighter as well... Shizuru-sensei... it appears she's not just a pair of boobs.)
Fuma-kun, would you snap out of it? If we break through here we should reach the forest where they hold experiments, let's go!
I can sense a faint miasma...
Yeah, I can hear an indistinct fluttering sound getting closer...
Is the queen coming for us?!
I could still hear that sound in my ears, even a short while later. It was almost like a strong ringing in the ears...
I don't know, maybe they had stayed in the forest to protect the queen... or the wasps that were out hunting came back.
I might have an idea... Shizuru-sensei, may I give orders?
Hehe☆ For tonight, just "Shizuru" is fine. I'll follow your lead! I have high expectations for your ability to issue commands, given the great showing you had when the rebellion happened.
Understood. Alright, make a circle! Support each other and guard each other's blind spots.
The fluttering sound was about to reach us.
